patch.value: Preserve verification accounting and checkpoint refusal contracts

Review threads PRRT_kwDOToJT7M6yWzcX and PRRT_kwDOToJT7M6yWzck identify valid general SDK reporting/compatibility gaps: checkpoint IO/budget failures now use VerificationRefusal rather than checkpoint-specific refusal guidance, and closure checked currently equals successfully verified nodes rather than attempted inspections. Both remain fail-closed and do not authorize unsafe pack/erasure behavior. Repair the result/refusal contracts separately without weakening verification or changing old read/export support.

Attempted work is distinguishable from successfully validated objects; Checkpoint failures retain checkpoint-specific instanceof and remedy compatibility alongside bounded verification results; Non-git behavioral tests cover corrupt missing valid and budget-exhausted cases without mutation
